test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph below gives the number of boys and girls in four different classes of a school.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55e2379a28622fbaeb9640c92e31d21f035f54c71f85e78d93f83051f9123205.png] 

As per the information provided in the bar graph, among all the four classes, which class has the least number of students, boys and girls taken together
solution:
**Concept Used:**

Total Students = Number of Boys + Number of Girls

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total number of students in class V = 65 + 58 = 123

⇒ Total number of students in class VI = 57 + 59 = 116

⇒ Total number of students in class VII = 60 + 62 = 122

⇒ Total number of students in class VIII = 61 + 59 = 120

**Hence, the least number of students taking boys and girls together is in class VI**
